image_description: A close-up portrait of an orangutan's face and upper shoulders. The subject has characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur framing a broad, flat face with dark skin. The eyes are amber/brown and forward-facing. The nose is broad and flat. The lighting appears soft, highlighting the texture of the fur and skin.

The reflection highlights in the eyes are somewhat uniform and lack complex environmental mapping, giving a slight 'glassy' or AI-generated look, though not structurally impossible.
